justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses newtype JobId, JobState enum, and typed QueueError, though Job's combination of state + Option<Instant> retry_at could be modeled more tightly via per-state data.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants and Display impl; uses an undocumented expect in checkout and panics via assert! in new instead of returning a Result.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Reasonable surface with appropriate derives, but no doc comments on any public item and no std::error::Error impl on QueueError.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic Rust with ?, derives, and HashMap usage, but the checkout loop could use iterator methods/matches! and the payload is cloned rather than borrowed.
